No masterclass

Downloads, then silence

Someone grabs your Secure Reframes Guide at midnight. The next thing on offer is a monthly coaching commitment. Most people need a step in between, so they stay on the list and never buy.

Bootcamp locked away

Your best product has no price tag

No ads

Live 60-minute masterclass · £15 seat

Stop the spiral. Start trusting yourself in love.

The 60-minute masterclass for anxious overthinkers who want to feel secure in their relationships, without needing constant reassurance.

Live on · [7pm UK time] · Replay included

Sound familiar?

You’ve always been called the sensitive one

  • When people seem a little off with you, your chest tightens and you assume something must be wrong.
  • Your confidence goes up and down like a yo-yo after small things, like a slow text back or a minor criticism.
  • You can’t say no to a request without feeling guilty for hours.
  • You’ve read every article on attachment styles, and you still replay the conversation at 1am.

What if their slow text back was never the real problem? What if the real problem was the relationship you have with yourself?

Here’s what you’ll learn

In 60 minutes, live with Rebecca

01

Why certainty won’t calm you

Why more reassurance from them never lasts, and what you actually need instead: self-trust.

02

The anatomy of a spiral

How one “what if” thought becomes a whole evening of overthinking, and where to interrupt it.

03

Secure reframes in the moment

Practical lines to use when the slow reply or change in tone hits, so you respond instead of react.

04

Your self-trust bubble

How to stay steady in the face of rejection without shutting down or chasing.

05

The CTFAR shift

The simple model Rebecca uses with 1:1 clients to change how a situation feels, not just how you think about it.

06

Live Q&A

Bring your situation. Rebecca will coach on real questions from the room.

Meet Rebecca

You don’t need certainty. You need self-trust.

Rebecca Ore is a relationship coach who helps anxious overthinkers enjoy their relationships. She hosts the Master Your Relationship Mind Drama podcast, with 270k+ downloads, and shares daily with 112k people on Instagram.

In her 1:1 coaching she uses the CTFAR method to help clients change how they respond in the moments that used to send them spiralling. Stop the Spiral is the first time she’s teaching the core of that work live, for £15.

FromRebecca Ore <[hello@rebeccaorecoaching.com]>Subject“I’ve tried everything already”PreviewWhy this time can feel different

Hi {first name},

If you’ve read the books, listened to the podcasts and learned your attachment style, and you still replay conversations at 1am, you’re not doing it wrong.

Knowing why you overthink and changing how you respond in the moment are two different skills. Most of what’s out there teaches the first one.

My 1:1 work is about the second: practical things to do in the moment, practised every week, with support between sessions on Voxer so you’re not on your own when it happens.

If that’s the part that’s been missing, let’s talk.
